scope: Every one of390 non-flowchart/non-sequence source/contract pairs in the548 occurrence inventory (34 normalized families)
reviewer: Codex implement_conformance, independently of the source transcriber and renderer/output observer
method: Every selected literal source and full expectation was read in bounded family batches. Pinned prose resolved concrete language ambiguities. Per-case notes index manual checks; they are not auto-generated pass verdicts. Independent numeric arithmetic supplements, rather than replaces, literal reading. No SUT/reference output, renderer invocation, generator equality check or model output was used as ground truth.
independenceLimit: Independent second-agent structural/domain source audit, not an external expert sign-off. A no-finding entry only means no discrepancy was found in this stated scope. Style/default presentation projections and observer capability/paint correctness require separate qualification.

findings.detail: First authored line is the effect/problem. The contract treats Blurry Photo and Process/User/Equipment/Environment as sibling roots, losing causal attachment to the effect. Pinned page explicitly distinguishes first line from following causes.
findings.resolution: Source contract corrected or strengthened; independent fix-delta review and output observer qualification remain separate

findings.detail: Declared domain regions/labels are absent from source facts, including empty framework144. Pinned prose says domains themselves render even without items. Title plus empty entry/transition arrays cannot establish this framework.
findings.resolution: Source contract corrected or strengthened; independent fix-delta review and output observer qualification remain separate

findings.detail: Two distinct labels in different columns use task id3, whereas pinned prose requires unique task IDs. Current complete contract assumes two distinct cards without resolving that contradiction; retain source ambiguity rather than making candidate-driven exclusions.
findings.resolution: Source ambiguity explicitly remains pending; no accuracy pass inferred

findings.detail: $tags="v1.0" is treated as an extraVisibleField and required painted label. It is a named metadata argument. Pinned signatures distinguish tags from descriptions and the feature list leaves tag/custom-tag support unchecked.

findings.detail: Pinned Markdown formatting example is expected with literal asterisks/underscores instead of displayed This is Markdown. Preserve raw identity separately from visible formatted text.
